Compartment 4.15.0 brings one-click agent connection, always-on memory instructions, and `/compartmentalize` skills to AntiGravity and Codex across macOS, Windows, and Linux, 100% offline, with zero network calls of any kind and a portable, encrypted `.vault` file you own and can back up or copy anywhere.

## Downloads

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `Compartment-4.15.0.pkg` | macOS on Apple silicon, one click, with the menu bar app |
| `Compartment-4.15.0.dmg` | macOS on Apple silicon, drag to Applications |
| `Compartment-4.15.0-intel.pkg` | macOS on Intel, one click |

| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | checksums of all of the above |

```bash
pipx install compartment && compartment init      # or: uv tool install compartment
```

## What's New

### First-Class AntiGravity & Codex Integration
- **One-click `AntiGravity` and `Codex` buttons in the menu bar, system tray, and Linux panel:** All five **Connect an agent** targets (`Claude`, `Hermes`, `OpenClaw`, `AntiGravity`, `Codex`) sit on a single horizontal row (`POPOVER_WIDTH = PANEL_WIDTH = 440`) with live per-agent connected status checks.
- **Always-on memory rules and `/compartmentalize` skills for AntiGravity and Codex:**
  - `compartment integrate antigravity` (and `compartment init` when AntiGravity is present) wires `~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json`, installs `/compartmentalize` into `~/.gemini/config/skills/compartmentalize/SKILL.md`, and installs an `always_on` rule at `~/.gemini/config/rules/compartment.md` covering reflexive `memory_search` recall, proactive `memory_store` / `memory_store_many` saving, `kind="fact"` vs. `kind="opinion"` updates, untrusted-data safety boundaries, and 3-way `/learn` routing (`Rules` vs. `Skills` vs. `Compartment` inside `learning_proposal.md`).
  - `compartment integrate codex` (and `compartment init` when Codex is present) wires `$CODEX_HOME/config.toml`, writes an idempotent managed memory block into `$CODEX_HOME/AGENTS.md` preserving existing user text, and installs a strict-frontmatter `$CODEX_HOME/skills/compartmentalize/SKILL.md` (`name` + `description`).
- **Full lifecycle support (`--refresh`, `--remove`, `uninstall`):** `compartment integrate --refresh` and `compartment update` keep the AntiGravity rule, Codex `AGENTS.md` block, and `/compartmentalize` skills up to date while backing up user-edited copies; `--remove` and `compartment uninstall` clean up untouched installs cleanly.

### CI & Packaging Hardening
- **Pinned GitHub Actions and Dependabot:** Every workflow action is pinned to its full commit SHA with automated weekly Dependabot updates, and test isolation prevents `cmd_uninstall` tests from touching developer home directories.
